title: ornithopus sativus subsp. roseus
intro: Ornithopus sativus subsp. roseus, commonly known as Rose Clover, is a plant species that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote digestive health and alleviate symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving gut motility. The therapeutic actions of Rose Clover include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and carminative effects, which contribute to its soothing properties on the digestive system. The bioactive constituents of Ornithopus sativus subsp. roseus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
